statements.statement: CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for the patient
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms and dizziness
The service was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial was based on coverage being available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
Prairie State Medicaid is the secondary payer
